purpose: Maps every Git identity that has ever authored a line surviving in HEAD to a contributor class and a rights basis. scripts/ip/build-ip-clean-room.mjs consults this register: a file can only be classified first-party proprietary when every surviving line is attributable to an identity whose rightsStatus is RESOLVED. Identities are matched by the SHA-256 of the lowercased Git author address, never by the address itself; display names are not load-bearing.
limits: Raw email addresses are never stored here. Identities are matched by emailsSha256, the SHA-256 of the lowercased Git author address, which is the same identifier CONTRIBUTORS.csv publishes. Recompute one with: printf %s "<address>" | tr A-Z a-z | sha256sum.
A rights basis recorded here is a position, not an adjudicated title. Git proves who committed, never who owns.
OWNER rights depend on the owner holding the rights personally rather than through an employer or a commissioning contract. That is outside the repository and is listed for the owner to confirm.

AI_ASSISTANT identities are recorded under provider terms that assign output rights to the operating user. Whether a purely machine-generated fragment attracts copyright at all is jurisdiction-dependent; see docs/ip/AI_ASSISTED_PROVENANCE.md.
An identity with rightsStatus UNRESOLVED blocks first-party classification of every file carrying its surviving lines. That is the intended behaviour and must not be relaxed by editing this file.

DECLARED DEPARTURE, REQUIRES OWNER RATIFICATION. docs/platform-v7/autopilot/scopes/ip-chain-of-title-ai-provenance-4515.json records the invariant that no contributor may be marked RESOLVED without a referenced signed instrument, and that absent one, all remain UNRESOLVED. This register marks the owner, the two AI assistant identities and the automation identities RESOLVED on a recorded rights basis instead: a rights holder does not execute an instrument with themselves, and tool output under provider terms has no counterparty to sign. The third-party human identity remains UNRESOLVED, which is what that invariant was protecting. This is a substantive departure from a recorded owner position. Ratify it or reverse it; do not treat it as settled.
